key_findings: Directory popularity is not execution capability; public-apis, awesome-mcp-servers, awesome and free-for-dev are discovery sources rather than runtimes.
Microsoft Playwright MCP is the highest-value candidate to standardize browser automation around the existing local read-only bridge.
Crawl4AI is the preferred first public-web extraction PoC because it is Apache-2.0, self-hostable, Python-based, MCP-capable and LLM-oriented.
Scrapling is a strong fallback for difficult permitted public pages but its stealth/anti-bot capabilities require tighter compliance controls.
OpenDesign is capable but currently redundant with existing design/document surfaces and has a high installation/maintenance footprint.
Firecrawl is technically strong but AGPL-3.0 and a heavier service footprint reduce priority while lower-friction alternatives are untested.

n8n is source-available/fair-code rather than OSI open source; internal use and commercial consulting/workflow building are allowed under its documented model, while embedding/providing n8n as a product/service can require separate licensing.
truth_limit: Repository metadata and public documentation were checked on 2026-10-14. Stars, licenses, pricing, free tiers and repository state can change; revalidate before adoption.
